# BIST-Analyst Web App Setup Guide

## Project: kazananlar Kulübü (Winners Club)
BIST Stock Analysis Dashboard with AI-powered Trading Signals

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Verify copilot-instructions.md file in .github directory
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
- [x] Scaffold the Project
- [x] Customize the Project with BIST components
- [x] Install Required Extensions
- [ ] Compile the Project (npm install required)
- [ ] Create and Run Task
- [ ] Launch the Project
- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete

## Project Details
- **Type:** Next.js (React) Web Application
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **Build Tool:** Next.js App Router
- **Features:** Multi-timeframe BIST stock analysis dashboard with technical/fundamental/macro/sentiment signals

## Development
Once setup is complete, run:
```bash
npm run dev
```
Then open http://localhost:3000
